questions.question: Whom did Elijah confront on Mount Carmel?
How did God show he was the true God on Carmel?
options: Rain poured down and drowned the false prophets
A great wind scattered the prophets of Baal
A sudden earthquake shook the altar of Baal
Fire fell from heaven and consumed Elijah's sacrifice
questions.answer: Fire fell from heaven and consumed Elijah's sacrifice

questions.question: After the contest, the drought ended with a heavy rain.
_____ called down fire from heaven, defeating the prophets of Baal.
The _____ of the LORD fell and consumed the sacrifice, the wood, and the stones.
